native_files.origin: Original BioRED 2022 release archive (BIORED.zip), downloaded from https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/lu/BioRED/BIORED.zip. The upstream archive ships each split in three equivalent formats (BioC JSON, BioC XML, and PubTator stand-off text); only the BioC JSON files are kept here because the bigbio loader reads those, and the other two are alternative encodings of the same annotations. To restore them, re-download BIORED.zip from the URL above.

contents.BioRED/Train.BioC.JSON: Training split, 400 abstracts, BioC JSON. Source for train.jsonl via the bigbio loader.
contents.BioRED/Dev.BioC.JSON: Development (validation) split, 100 abstracts, BioC JSON. Source for validation.jsonl.
contents.BioRED/Test.BioC.JSON: Test split, 100 abstracts, BioC JSON. Source for test.jsonl.

native_files.relationship_to_jsonl: train/validation/test.jsonl in this folder are produced by the bigbio loading script from Train/Dev/Test.BioC.JSON. Note: the upstream files annotate a 'novel' boolean per relation (whether the relation is a novel finding in the abstract vs known background); the bigbio_kb shape does not preserve this flag, so it is not present in the JSONL. If you need it, parse the BioC JSON in native/ directly.

id: Row index within the JSONL file (string, '0', '1', ...). Not the PMID. (Note: differs from BC5CDR / NCBI Disease where `id` equals the PMID.)

passages.text: Passage text in a one-element list.
passages.offsets: Character span [start, end] of the passage in the concatenated document. Title starts at 0; abstract starts at len(title) + 1 (one space joins them).

entities.text: Entity surface text in a one-element list.
entities.offsets: Character span [start, end] of the mention.
entities.normalized: List of {db_name, db_id} entries. Most entities have one; ambiguous mentions (e.g. 'MODY' that maps to multiple genes) carry several.
entities.normalized.db_name: One of: 'NCBIGene' (genes), 'MESH' (diseases and chemicals), 'OMIM' (some diseases), 'NCBITaxon' (species), 'dbSNP' / 'tmVar' (variants), 'Cellosaurus' (cell lines).
entities.normalized.db_id: Identifier in the corresponding database (e.g. NCBIGene '3175', MESH 'D003924', NCBITaxon '9606', dbSNP 'rs74805019').

relations.type: One of eight relation types: 'Association', 'Positive_Correlation', 'Negative_Correlation', 'Bind', 'Cotreatment', 'Comparison', 'Drug_Interaction', 'Conversion'. Relations are annotated at the document level (any two mentions referring to the related concepts anywhere in the abstract count); a single document can have hundreds of relation rows because every co-mentioned pair is enumerated.
relations.arg1_id: Entity id of the first argument.
relations.arg2_id: Entity id of the second argument.
relations.normalized: Always [] in this corpus (bigbio_kb shape includes the field; BioRED relations are not normalized to an ontology).
